title: Assault Rifle
caption: Assault Rifle (V)
game_text: Deploy on Chief Bast or your Imperial warrior. May target a character, creature, or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: BlasTech model DLT-19 “heavy blaster rifle.” Enhanced with extra power packs and greater range.
